title: 第1章 发营妻群狼乱舞，选弱女孤注一掷
slug: 边军从领取罪女开始一统天下
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“谁踩老子手了？”

周起骂了一句，猛地坐起来。

脑袋像是有东西在里面乱钻，疼得厉害。

他下意识伸手去摸后脑勺，摸到了一手黏糊糊的血痂。

“喊什么喊？没死就爬起来排队！今天发婆娘，去晚了连老太婆都抢不到！”

一个粗粝的嗓门在耳边炸响。

周起晃了晃脑袋，视线终于聚焦。

眼前是一个露天的土场，四周围着篱笆。

百十号穿着破烂号衣的汉子正像发情的公狗一样，拼命往前面挤。

记忆在这个时候如潮水一样涌上来。

大宁朝，凉北道，破阵营。

自己穿越了。

周起是龙国老A特种部队指挥官，睡梦中醒来，现在成了这个同样名为周起的边军小卒。

这具身体的主人昨天刚在一场小规模的遭遇战被人敲破了脑袋，昏死过去，结果被扔在伤兵营自生自灭。

“发婆娘？”

周起眯着眼，看向人群最前方。

那里站着两排女人。

说是女人，其实更像是一群待宰的牲口。

她们大多衣衫褴褛，手脚上带着镣铐，有的脸上还有刺字。

这是“营妻”。

宁朝律法，边军苦寒，为防哗变，朝廷会将犯官家眷、流放的女囚充入军营，配给士卒。

这是恩典，也是这群女人的地狱。

“咱俩要那个吧！那个看着能挺老实！”两个汉子商量着。

边军小卒粮饷微薄，有些关系好的兵卒俩人合起伙来养一个婆娘，生出来的孩子也不知是谁的，就一起养着。

这乱世兵卒，谁也说不准哪天就死在战场上，俩人娶一个，女人孩子日后有人照看的机会反倒大了不少。

“我要这个！这个屁股大！”

“滚一边去，那个是老子的！这个身板一看就抗造，你半刻就能完事，你用不着选这么壮实的！”

“对，你那家伙事儿精细的，跟这娘们儿的体格也不配套啊！”

“别抢！再抢老子动刀了！这个我们营房要了。”

前面的兵油子们已经动上了手，推搡喝骂声响成一片。

在这些整天把脑袋别在裤腰带上的丘八眼里，审美标准非常统一，要壮，要胖，要能干活，最好屁股大能生儿子。

至于脸蛋漂不漂亮？

那是虚的。

灯一吹都一样，但能不能帮你洗那一盆像石头一样沉的血衣，能不能在冬天帮你暖好那像冰窟窿一样的被窝，这才是实打实的。

周起没急着挤进去。

他靠在后面一根烂木桩上，双手抱胸，冷眼看着这场闹剧。

脑子里的痛感稍微退去了一些，他开始评估现在的处境。

破阵营第十队，最烂的一队。

缺衣少食，装备全是破烂，住的是漏风土屋。

想要在这个鬼地方活下去，还要活得像个人，光靠蛮力不行。

得靠脑子。

“周起？你小子诈尸了？”

旁边凑过来一个满嘴黄牙的老兵，手里抓着半个窝头，一脸惊奇地看着他，“昨天我看你都快没气了，正打算今晚把你铺盖卷分了呢。”

周起瞥了他一眼。

这是同屋的老赖皮，叫吴老三。

“命硬，阎王爷嫌我吃得多，不收。”周起随口回了一句，目光依旧在那些女人身上扫视。

“既然活了，就赶紧去抢啊。昨天战场上活下来的，可以优先选。”吴老三把最后一点窝头塞进嘴里，含糊不清地说道，“你看前面那几个壮实的，都被一队二队那帮孙子挑走了。剩下的都是些歪瓜裂枣。”

前排那些看起来身体健康、脸色稍微红润一点的女人，早就被几个强壮的伍长和老兵抢走了。

剩下的，要么是年纪大的，要么是瘦得只剩一把骨头的，还有几个身上带着残疾。

周起的目光正准备扫向角落，人群中突然爆发出一阵尖锐的哭喊声。

“放开我！别碰我家小姐！滚开啊！”

周起顺着声音看去。

只见角落里，两个女人正纠缠在一起。或者说，是一个瘦小的丫头正死死挡在一个蓬头垢面的女人身前。

那丫头看着年纪不大，虽然也穿着囚衣，可护主的狠劲儿却不小，一口咬住一只伸过来的粗手。

“哎哟！属狗的啊！”

被咬的汉子惨叫一声，随即勃然大怒。

那汉子满脸横肉，正是隔壁第十一队的一个什长赵大嘴，出了名的心黑手狠。

“啪！”

"Who stepped on me?"

Zhou Qi cursed and sat up suddenly.

It felt like something was burrowing inside my head, and it hurt terribly.

He subconsciously reached out to touch the back of his head and touched a sticky bloody scab on his hand.

"What are you shouting for? Get up and line up if you're still alive! I'm going to send my mother-in-law today. I'm late and even the old woman can't get it!"

A rough voice rang in his ears.

Zhou Qi shook his head and his eyes finally focused.

In front of you is an open-air dirt field surrounded by fences.

The man No. 100 in tattered uniform was pushing forward like a male dog in heat.

Memories came flooding back at this time.

The Ning Dynasty, Liangbei Road, broke the camp.

He traveled through time himself.

Zhou Qi is the commander of the Long Kingdom's old A special forces. He woke up from his sleep and is now a border soldier named Zhou Qi.

The owner of this body had his head cracked in a small-scale encounter yesterday, passed out, and was left to fend for himself in the wounded barracks.

"Father-in-law?"

Zhou Qi squinted and looked towards the front of the crowd.

There were two rows of women standing there.

They say they are women, but in fact they are more like a group of animals waiting to be slaughtered.

Most of them were in ragged clothes, with shackles on their hands and feet, and some had tattoos on their faces.

This is "camp wife".

According to the laws of the Ning Dynasty, the frontier army was suffering from bitter cold. In order to prevent mutiny, the imperial court would send the family members of prisoners and exiled female prisoners into the military camps and ration them to the soldiers.

This is grace and this is hell for these women.

"Let's go for that one! That one looks quite honest!" The two men discussed.

The soldiers in the border army received meager food and wages. Some soldiers who were close to each other teamed up to raise a mother-in-law. They didn't know whose child they gave birth to, so they raised it together.

In this troubled world, no one can predict which day a soldier will die on the battlefield. If two people marry one, the chance of a woman and child being taken care of in the future is actually much greater.

"I want this! This butt is big!"

"Get out of here, that one belongs to me! This body is tough at first sight. You can finish it in just a moment. You don't need to choose someone so strong!"

"Yes, that guy of yours is very sophisticated, but his physique doesn't match this girl's!"

"Don't grab it! If you grab it again, I'll use the knife! We want this in the barracks."

The soldiers in front had already taken action, and there was a loud sound of pushing and cursing.

In the eyes of these Qiu Ba, who keep their heads in their belts all day long, the beauty standards are very uniform. They must be strong, fat, able to work, and preferably have a big butt so that they can have sons.

As for whether your face is pretty?

That's false.

It's all the same when the lamp is blown, but the real deal is whether it can help you wash that basin of bloody clothes that is as heavy as a stone, and whether it can help you warm your bed that is like an ice hole in the winter.

Zhou Qi was in no hurry to squeeze in.

He leaned against a rotten wooden stake behind him, folded his arms, and watched the farce with cold eyes.

The pain in his head subsided a little, and he began to evaluate the current situation.

The tenth team in the broken camp, the worst team.

They lacked food and clothing, their equipment was all in tatters, and they lived in a leaky earth house.

If you want to survive in this hellish place and live like a human being, you can't rely on brute force alone.

It depends on your brain.

"Zhou Qi? Did you fake the corpse?"

A veteran with yellow teeth came up next to him, holding half a nest in his hand and looking at him in surprise, "I saw you were almost out of breath yesterday, and I was planning to divide your bedroll tonight."

Zhou Qi glanced at him.

This is the old scoundrel who lives in the same room, named Wu Laosan.

"My life is tough. The Lord of Hell thinks I have eaten too much, so he won't accept it." Zhou Qi replied casually, his eyes still scanning those women.

"Since you are alive, hurry up and grab them. Those who survived yesterday's battlefield can be given priority." Wu Laosan stuffed the last bit of cornbread into his mouth and said vaguely, "Look at the strong ones in front, all of them were picked away by the grandsons of the first team and the second team. The rest are all crooked melons and cracked jujubes."

Those women in the front row who looked healthy and had a slightly rosy face had long been snatched away by a few strong captains and veterans.

The rest are either old or so thin that they have only a handful of bones left, and a few have disabilities.

Zhou Qi was about to glance towards the corner when a sharp cry suddenly broke out from the crowd.

"Let me go! Don't touch my lady! Get away!"

Zhou Qi looked along the sound.

I saw two women entangled in the corner.In other words, it was a skinny girl standing in front of an unkempt woman.

The girl looked young, and even though she was wearing a prison uniform, her protector was very fierce, and she bit down on a thick hand that was stretched out.

"Ouch! He's a dog!"

The bitten man screamed and then became furious.

That man had a sinister face. He was none other than Zhao Dazui, the commander of Team 11 next door. He was famous for his evil intentions and ruthless hands.

"Crack!"
